- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptCatalog.put_file_at_a_new_path_is_owned_by_the_caller`** — A file upload at a new path creates a row owned by the uploading principal.
  - Statement: `∀ (ws : AgentWorkspace.WorkspaceId) (fresh : AgentWorkspace.FileId) (input : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.PutFile) (fs : List AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File), (∀ (f : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File), f ∈ fs → f.path ≠ input.path) → ∃ f', f' ∈ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.putFile ws fresh input fs ∧ f'.id = fresh ∧ f'.owner = input.owner ∧ f'.workspace = ws ∧ f'.path = input.path`
  - Cites: `docs/sdk/site/concepts/ownership-and-sharing.mdx#what-you-can-and-cannot-do-today`, `packages/core/src/db/repositories/resource-catalogs.ts#CatalogFile`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptCatalog.put_file_never_transfers_owner`** — A file upload at a path that already exists updates the row's content and never its id, owner or creator: "an upsert at an existing path never transfers it".
  - Statement: `∀ (ws : AgentWorkspace.WorkspaceId) (fresh : AgentWorkspace.FileId) (input : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.PutFile) (fs : List AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File) (f : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File), f ∈ fs → f.path = input.path → ∃ f', f' ∈ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.putFile ws fresh input fs ∧ f'.id = f.id ∧ f'.owner = f.owner ∧ f'.createdBy = f.createdBy ∧ f'.path = input.path ∧ f'.storageKey = input.storageKey`
  - Cites: `packages/core/src/db/repositories/resource-catalogs.ts#CatalogFile`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptCatalog.put_skill_never_transfers_owner`** — A skill import under a name that already exists updates `SKILL.md` and `enabled` and never the row's id, owner or creator.
  - Statement: `∀ (ws : AgentWorkspace.WorkspaceId) (fresh : AgentWorkspace.SkillId) (input : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Skill.PutSkill) (ss : List AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Skill.Skill) (s : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Skill.Skill), s ∈ ss → s.name = input.name → ∃ s', s' ∈ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Skill.putSkill ws fresh input ss ∧ s'.id = s.id ∧ s'.owner = s.owner ∧ s'.createdBy = s.createdBy ∧ s'.skillMd = input.skillMd`
  - Cites: `packages/core/src/db/repositories/resource-catalogs.ts#CatalogSkill`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptCatalog.read_narrows_stale_write_access`** — Whatever access a stored `agent_files` row carries, reading an agent's assignments without its `writeFiles` permission yields only `read` access (a stale `read-write` row is narrowed on read).
  - Statement: `∀ (p : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Agent.Permissions) (stored : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.Assignments), p.writeFiles = false → ∀ (f : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.FileEntry), f ∈ (AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.effective p stored).files → f.access = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.FileAccess.read`
  - Cites: `docs/adr/W9-UI-133-permission-cap-narrows-at-read-and-write.md#decision`, `packages/core/src/db/repositories/agent-resources.ts#createDatabaseAgentResourceRepositoryProvider`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptCatalog.reference_names_one_parent`** — In a consistent state, a row whose foreign key is set names exactly one parent row, provided the key targets an exact key of the parent.
  - Statement: `∀ (S : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Schema) (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State), AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.consistent S st = true → ∀ {t : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName} {fk : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.ForeignKey}, fk ∈ (S t).foreignKeys → AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.Catalog.targetIsExactKey S fk = true → ∀ {r : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row}, r ∈ st t → r.present fk.columns = true → ∃ r', r' ∈ st fk.refTable ∧ r'.project fk.refColumns = r.project fk.columns ∧ ∀ (r'' : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row), r'' ∈ st fk.refTable → r''.project fk.refColumns = r.project fk.columns → r'' = r'`
  - Cites: `docs/sdk/07-structure-map.md#3-er-diagram--the-tables-the-sdk-surfaces`, `packages/core/src/db/schema/tenancy.test.ts#tenantPairingFault`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptCatalog.rename_by_prefix_keeps_every_identity`** — A subtree move rewrites paths by `UPDATE`, so every row keeps its id, workspace, owner and creator, and with them every assignment and project link that names it.
  - Statement: `∀ (old new : String) (fs : List AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File), List.map (fun f => (f.id, f.workspace, f.owner, f.createdBy)) (AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.renameByPrefix old new fs) = List.map (fun f => (f.id, f.workspace, f.owner, f.createdBy)) fs`
  - Cites: `docs/sdk/04-api-specification.md#56-files--awfiles`, `packages/core/src/db/repositories/resource-catalogs.ts#ResourceCatalogRepository`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptCatalog.rename_by_prefix_keeps_the_key_at_the_path`** — A subtree move keeps each file's object key at its path: a row whose key is its own path (as every upload writes it) or which is a folder with no key still has that shape after the move.
  - Statement: `∀ (old new : String) (fs : List AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File), (∀ (f : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File), f ∈ fs → f.storageKey = if f.kind = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.FileKind.file then some f.path else none) → ∀ (g : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File), g ∈ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.renameByPrefix old new fs → g.storageKey = if g.kind = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.FileKind.file then some g.path else none`
  - Cites: `packages/core/src/db/repositories/resource-catalogs.ts#createDatabaseResourceCatalogRepositoryProvider`, `packages/core/src/db/schema/files.ts#files`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptCatalog.rename_by_prefix_leaves_other_rows_alone`** — A subtree move leaves every row outside the prefix exactly as it was.
  - Statement: `∀ (old new : String) (fs : List AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File) (f : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File), f ∈ fs → AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.underPrefix old f.path = false → f ∈ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.renameByPrefix old new fs`
  - Cites: `packages/core/src/db/repositories/resource-catalogs.ts#pathUnderPrefix`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptCatalog.rename_by_prefix_moves_the_rows_under_it`** — A subtree move renames every row under the prefix: its new path is the new prefix followed by what followed the old one.
  - Statement: `∀ (old new : String) (fs : List AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File) (f : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File), f ∈ fs → AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.underPrefix old f.path = true → ∃ g, g ∈ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.renameByPrefix old new fs ∧ g.id = f.id ∧ g.path = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.renamePath old new f.path`
  - Cites: `packages/core/src/db/repositories/resource-catalogs.ts#createDatabaseResourceCatalogRepositoryProvider`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptCatalog.rename_file_is_missing_iff_no_row`** — A single-file rename answers `null` exactly when no row of the workspace is at the old path.
  - Statement: `∀ (path : String) (input : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.RenameFile) (fs : List AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File), AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.renameFile path input fs = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.RenameOutcome.missing ↔ ∀ (f : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File), f ∈ fs → f.path ≠ path`
  - Cites: `packages/core/src/db/repositories/resource-catalogs.ts#createDatabaseResourceCatalogRepositoryProvider`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptCatalog.rename_file_keeps_the_rows_identity`** — A single-file rename (`renameFile`) is an `UPDATE` of the row at the old path: the returned row keeps that row's id, workspace, owner and creator, carries the new path, and is in the new catalog ("a rename changes the row's path and content metadata, never who owns or originally created it").
  - Statement: `∀ (path : String) (input : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.RenameFile) (fs fs' : List AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File) (row : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File), AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.renameFile path input fs = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.RenameOutcome.renamed fs' row → ∃ f, f ∈ fs ∧ f.path = path ∧ row.id = f.id ∧ row.workspace = f.workspace ∧ row.owner = f.owner ∧ row.createdBy = f.createdBy ∧ row.path = input.path ∧ row ∈ fs'`
  - Cites: `packages/core/src/db/repositories/resource-catalogs.ts#ResourceCatalogRepository`, `packages/core/src/db/repositories/resource-catalogs.ts#createDatabaseResourceCatalogRepositoryProvider`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptCatalog.rename_file_leaves_other_rows_alone`** — A single-file rename leaves every row at another path exactly as it was.
  - Statement: `∀ (path : String) (input : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.RenameFile) (fs fs' : List AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File) (row g : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File), AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.renameFile path input fs = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.RenameOutcome.renamed fs' row → g ∈ fs → g.path ≠ path → g ∈ fs'`
  - Cites: `packages/core/src/db/repositories/resource-catalogs.ts#createDatabaseResourceCatalogRepositoryProvider`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptCatalog.rename_file_never_takes_an_occupied_path`** — A single-file rename never lands on a path another row holds: a successful rename either keeps the path or moves the row to a path no row had (PostgreSQL raises the `files_workspace_path_key` violation otherwise).
  - Statement: `∀ (path : String) (input : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.RenameFile) (fs fs' : List AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File) (row : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File), AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.renameFile path input fs = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.RenameOutcome.renamed fs' row → input.path = path ∨ ∀ (g : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File), g ∈ fs → g.path ≠ input.path`
  - Cites: `packages/core/src/db/schema/files.ts#files`, `packages/core/src/db/repositories/resource-catalogs.ts#createDatabaseResourceCatalogRepositoryProvider`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptCatalog.replace_answers_in_id_order`** — The answer of a successful replacement lists files, skills and connectors each in ascending id order, as `read(agentId)` returns them (`orderBy(asc(...))`), not in request order.
  - Statement: `∀ (p : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Agent.Permissions) (cat : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.CatalogIds) (req a : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.Assignments), AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.replace (some p) cat req = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.ReplaceOutcome.updated a → List.Pairwise (fun f g => f.file ≤ g.file) a.files ∧ List.Pairwise (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) a.skills ∧ List.Pairwise (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) a.connectors`
  - Cites: `packages/core/src/db/repositories/agent-resources.ts#createDatabaseAgentResourceRepositoryProvider`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptCatalog.replace_assigns_only_catalogued_resources`** — Replacing an agent's assignments writes only ids that name a file, skill or connector of the agent's own workspace catalog: "importing a skill puts it in the workspace's catalog; assigning it is what makes one particular agent's runs able to load it".
  - Statement: `∀ (p : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Agent.Permissions) (cat : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.CatalogIds) (req a : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.Assignments), AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.replace (some p) cat req = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.ReplaceOutcome.updated a → (∀ (f : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.FileEntry), f ∈ a.files → f.file ∈ cat.files) ∧ (∀ (k : String), k ∈ a.skills → k ∈ cat.skills) ∧ ∀ (c : String), c ∈ a.connectors → c ∈ cat.connectors`
  - Cites: `docs/sdk/site/concepts/ownership-and-sharing.mdx#catalog-assignment-grant`, `packages/core/src/db/repositories/agent-resources.ts#createDatabaseAgentResourceRepositoryProvider`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptCatalog.replace_checks_files_then_skills_then_connectors`** — The check order, read back from the answer: an `unknown-skill` answer means every file id was distinct and catalogued, and an `unknown-connector` answer means that and every skill id was catalogued; the id named is a requested id outside the catalog.
  - Statement: `∀ (p : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Agent.Permissions) (cat : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.CatalogIds) (req : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.Assignments) (id : String), (AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.replace (some p) cat req = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.ReplaceOutcome.unknownSkill id → (List.map (fun x => x.file) req.files).Nodup ∧ (∀ (f : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.FileEntry), f ∈ req.files → f.file ∈ cat.files) ∧ id ∈ req.skills ∧ ¬id ∈ cat.skills) ∧ (AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.replace (some p) cat req = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.ReplaceOutcome.unknownConnector id → (List.map (fun x => x.file) req.files).Nodup ∧ (∀ (f : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.FileEntry), f ∈ req.files → f.file ∈ cat.files) ∧ (∀ (k : String), k ∈ req.skills → k ∈ cat.skills) ∧ id ∈ req.connectors ∧ ¬id ∈ cat.connectors)`
  - Cites: `packages/core/src/db/repositories/agent-resources.ts#ReplaceAgentResourcesOutcome`, `packages/core/src/db/repositories/agent-resources.ts#createDatabaseAgentResourceRepositoryProvider`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptCatalog.replace_keeps_every_requested_id`** — The answer of a successful replacement holds every requested file, skill and connector id and no other, whatever order the request used (the answer is the read-back, in id order).
  - Statement: `∀ (p : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Agent.Permissions) (cat : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.CatalogIds) (req a : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.Assignments), AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.replace (some p) cat req = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.ReplaceOutcome.updated a → (∀ (k : String), k ∈ a.skills ↔ k ∈ req.skills) ∧ (∀ (c : String), c ∈ a.connectors ↔ c ∈ req.connectors) ∧ (List.map (fun x => x.file) a.files).Perm (List.map (fun x => x.file) req.files)`
  - Cites: `packages/core/src/db/repositories/agent-resources.ts#createDatabaseAgentResourceRepositoryProvider`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptCatalog.replace_never_widens_past_write_files`** — An agent's written file assignments never exceed what was requested, and without the agent's own `writeFiles` permission every one of them is `read` ("narrow, never widen").
  - Statement: `∀ (p : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Agent.Permissions) (cat : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.CatalogIds) (req a : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.Assignments), AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.replace (some p) cat req = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.ReplaceOutcome.updated a → ∀ (f : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.FileEntry), f ∈ a.files → ∃ g, g ∈ req.files ∧ g.file = f.file ∧ f.access.le g.access = true ∧ (p.writeFiles = false → f.access = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.FileAccess.read)`
  - Cites: `docs/adr/W9-UI-133-permission-cap-narrows-at-read-and-write.md#decision`, `packages/core/src/db/repositories/agent-resources.ts#createDatabaseAgentResourceRepositoryProvider`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptCatalog.replace_reports_the_first_uncatalogued_connector`** — Replacement checks the connector ids last: when every file id is distinct and catalogued, every skill id is catalogued, and `id` is the first requested connector id that names no connector of the workspace, the answer is `unknown-connector` naming `id`.
  - Statement: `∀ (p : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Agent.Permissions) (cat : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.CatalogIds) (req : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.Assignments) (pre post : List String) (id : String), (List.map (fun x => x.file) req.files).Nodup → (∀ (f : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.FileEntry), f ∈ req.files → f.file ∈ cat.files) → (∀ (k : String), k ∈ req.skills → k ∈ cat.skills) → req.connectors = pre ++ id :: post → (∀ (x : String), x ∈ pre → x ∈ cat.connectors) → ¬id ∈ cat.connectors → AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.replace (some p) cat req = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Grant.ReplaceOutcome.unknownConnector id`

- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptCatalog.replace_reports_the_first_uncatalogued_file`** — Replacement checks the file ids first: when the file ids are distinct and `id` is the first requested file id that names no file of the workspace, the answer is `unknown-file` naming `id`, whatever the skills and connectors are.

- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptPublication.published_mode_and_budget_fit`** — An admitted publish gives a mode exactly to an agent share, and a budget exactly to a runnable one: the two row-local halves of `wellPublished` hold for everything the service writes.

- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptWork.append_prunes_at_the_cutoff_and_keeps_the_newest`** — The repository's `append` prunes exactly at the cutoff: once `cutoff = next - maxEvents` is positive, every event the run keeps has a sequence above it; and with room for at least one event, the event just appended is always kept. Together with contiguity this bounds a run's stored log to its newest `maxEvents` events.

- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptWork.set_reference_has_a_target`** — In every consistent state, a row whose foreign-key columns are all set references a parent row through that key (PostgreSQL's `MATCH SIMPLE`).

- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptWork.store_durations_are_exact`** — The model's durations are exact: every run the store operations produce from a well-formed run (with a clock that never runs backwards) ends no earlier than it starts, so the natural-number `durationMs` is the integer difference `endedAt - startedAt` that `renderRun` computes, never a truncated negative one.

  - Cites: `apps/web/server/runs/api.ts#renderRun`, `packages/core/src/db/schema/runs.ts#runs_ended_after_started`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptWork.store_operations_preserve_run_checks`** — Every run check is preserved by every sequence of store operations whose clock never runs behind the run's own timestamps: `markRunning` and `finish` never produce a row that `runs_ended_at_iff_terminal` or `runs_ended_after_started` refuses, and leave the accounting checks untouched.

- **`Theorems.Invariants.ConceptWork.store_stamps_follow_the_status`** — What each store operation writes, status by status: `markRunning` on a queued run moves it to `running` and stamps `startedAt` with the store's clock (and nothing else); `finish` with a terminal target on a live run moves it there, stamps `endedAt`, and stamps `startedAt` only if the run never had one; every other call writes nothing, because the store refuses it (`markRunning` on a non-queued run answers `false`, `finish` with a non-terminal target rejects or throws) or ignores it (`finish` on an already terminal run).

- **`Theorems.Invariants.EnginePort.absent_and_unloadable_are_the_same_refusal`** — An engine absent from the table is refused, and an engine present but unloadable is refused the same way. From the caller's side those are one fact about this image.
  - Statement: `∀ (version dir : String), AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.loadEngine [] "openai-agents-sdk" = AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.Lookup.refused AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.Refusal.engineNotInstalled ∧ AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.loadEngine [{ id := "claude-agent-sdk", version := version, protectedConfigDirectory := dir, loads := false }] "claude-agent-sdk" = AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.Lookup.refused AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.Refusal.engineNotInstalled`
  - Cites: `apps/runner/src/engines.ts#loadEngine`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.EnginePort.an_image_with_no_adapter_reports_none`** — An image carrying no adapter reports no engines, which is the `/healthz` half of the acceptance criterion.
  - Statement: `AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.installedEngines [{ id := "claude-agent-sdk", version := "0.3.278", protectedConfigDirectory := ".claude", loads := false }] = []`
  - Cites: `apps/runner/src/engines.ts#installedEngines`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.EnginePort.every_refusal_before_start_emits_no_frame`** — Every refusal *before start* emits no frame and answers `run-error` with the refusal's code: the engine did not load, or it loaded and `compile` refused. Stated over the refusal rather than over the terminal name, so it does not depend on `run-error` meaning only a refusal — which it does not in the server, where a run that fails mid-stream also ends with `run-error`.
  - Statement: `∀ (table : List AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.InstalledAdapter) (capabilities : AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.Capabilities) (request : AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.Request) (projectKey configDir : String) (framesIfStarted : Nat) (reason : AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.Refusal), AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.loadEngine table request.engine = AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.Lookup.refused reason ∨ (∃ adapter, AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.loadEngine table request.engine = AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.Lookup.found adapter) ∧ AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.compileTarget capabilities request projectKey configDir = AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.CompileResult.refused reason → (AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.serveRun table capabilities request projectKey configDir framesIfStarted).frames = 0 ∧ (AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.serveRun table capabilities request projectKey configDir framesIfStarted).terminal = "run-error" ∧ (AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.serveRun table capabilities request projectKey configDir framesIfStarted).code = some reason.code`
  - Cites: `apps/runner/src/runtime.ts#startEngineAgent`, `apps/runner/src/run-handler.ts#streamEngineRefusal`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.EnginePort.every_refusal_emits_no_frame`** — In the model, a `run-error` terminal carries no frame — because the model's only `run-error` is a refusal *before start*. A policy the adapter cannot read and a credential it refuses are decided by `compile`, which runs before `start`, so the property is about the *ordering* rather than about one code. Read the hypothesis as "the model answered `run-error`", not as "the server sent `run-error`": `apps/runner/src/server.ts` also ends a run that started, streamed frames and then threw with `run-error`, and `serveRun` has no arm for such a mid-stream failure. The implementation-shaped statement is `every_refusal_before_start_emits_no_frame` below, which is quantified over the refusal itself and stays true whatever arms `RunOutcome` later gains.
  - Statement: `∀ (table : List AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.InstalledAdapter) (capabilities : AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.Capabilities) (request : AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.Request) (projectKey configDir : String) (framesIfStarted : Nat), (AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.serveRun table capabilities request projectKey configDir framesIfStarted).terminal = "run-error" → (AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.serveRun table capabilities request projectKey configDir framesIfStarted).frames = 0`
  - Cites: `apps/runner/src/runtime.ts#startEngineAgent`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.EnginePort.healthz_reports_only_what_loaded`** — `/healthz` never reports an engine whose package did not load. This is the other half of the same claim: the catalogue's `installed` flag is the result of loading, not a reading of a list.
  - Statement: `∀ (table : List AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.InstalledAdapter) (id version : String), (id, version) ∈ AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.installedEngines table → ∃ row, row ∈ table ∧ row.id = id ∧ row.version = version ∧ row.loads = true`
  - Cites: `apps/runner/src/engines.ts#installedEngines`, `apps/runner/src/server.ts#listEngines`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.EnginePort.unregistered_engine_emits_no_frame`** — An engine this image does not carry produces **zero** frames, whatever the engine would have produced had it been there. Quantified over `framesIfStarted`, which is exactly the "before any output" claim: the number of frames a started run would have made cannot change the answer.
  - Statement: `∀ (table : List AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.InstalledAdapter) (capabilities : AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.Capabilities) (request : AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.Request) (projectKey configDir : String) (framesIfStarted : Nat), AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.loadEngine table request.engine = AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.Lookup.refused AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.Refusal.engineNotInstalled → AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.EnginePort.serveRun table capabilities request projectKey configDir framesIfStarted = { frames := 0, terminal := "run-error", code := some "engine_not_installed" }`
  - Cites: `docs/sdk/site/building/extending-the-platform.mdx#registering-it`, `apps/runner/src/engines.ts#loadEngine`, `apps/runner/src/run-handler.ts#streamEngineRefusal`

- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.composite_reference_stays_in_workspace`** — In any state of today's database, consistent or not, a reference through a composite foreign key joins two rows of the same workspace.

  - Cites: `docs/sdk/07-structure-map.md#3-er-diagram--the-tables-the-sdk-surfaces`, `packages/core/src/db/schema/tenancy.test.ts#tenantPairingFault`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.cross_workspace_write_is_rolled_back`** — A transaction whose writes would leave a reference from one workspace to a tenant-carrying row of another is rolled back: the database stays in the state before it.
  - Statement: `∀ (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State) (tx : List AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.Stmt) {t : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName} {fk : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.ForeignKey} {r r' : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row}, (AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue fk.refTable).tenantColumn?.isSome = true → AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.References AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue (AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.run tx st) t fk r r' → AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.tenantOf AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue t r ≠ AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.tenantOf AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue fk.refTable r' → AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.commit AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.consistent st tx = st`
  - Cites: `docs/architecture.md#runtime-and-trust-boundaries`, `packages/core/src/db/schema/tenancy.test.ts#tenantPairingFault`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.empty_database_is_consistent`** — The empty database satisfies every constraint of today's whole schema.
  - Statement: `AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.consistent AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State.empty = true`
  - Cites: `docs/formal/inventory.md#5-db-tables-packagescoresrcdbschemats-33-tables`, `packages/core/src/db/schema/index.ts`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.every_cluster_check_is_enforced`** — For each of the five clusters there is a state that satisfies every constraint of the bare catalogue yet is inconsistent for the whole schema, because it breaks exactly one check that only that cluster gives a meaning to.
  - Statement: `List.map (fun x => x.fst) AgentWorkspace.Er.Refinement.Refusals.cells = AgentWorkspace.WireEnum.all ∧ (AgentWorkspace.Er.Refinement.Refusals.cells.all fun x => match x with | (c, st, t, n) => AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.consistent AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue st && !AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.consistent st && AgentWorkspace.Er.Refinement.currentViolations st == [n] && AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.refinedBy t n == [c]) = true`
  - Cites: `docs/formal/inventory.md#5-db-tables-packagescoresrcdbschemats-33-tables`, `packages/core/src/db/schema/index.ts`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.every_composite_key_is_tenant_paired`** — Every composite foreign key of today's schema pairs the child's tenant column with the parent's, so the database itself compares the two workspaces as part of the key.
  - Statement: `∀ (t : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName) (fk : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.ForeignKey), fk ∈ (AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue t).foreignKeys → 2 ≤ fk.columns.length → AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.isPaired AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue t fk = true`
  - Cites: `docs/sdk/07-structure-map.md#3-er-diagram--the-tables-the-sdk-surfaces`, `packages/core/src/db/schema/tenancy.test.ts#tenantPairingFault`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.no_cross_workspace_reference`** — In every consistent state of today's whole schema, no foreign-key reference joins a row of one workspace to a tenant-carrying row of another.
  - Statement: `∀ (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State), AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.consistent st = true → ∀ {t : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName} {fk : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.ForeignKey} {r r' : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row}, (AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue fk.refTable).tenantColumn?.isSome = true → AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.References AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue st t fk r r' → AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.tenantOf AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue t r = AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.tenantOf AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue fk.refTable r'`
  - Cites: `docs/architecture.md#runtime-and-trust-boundaries`, `docs/formal/inventory.md#4-tenant-isolation-predicates`, `packages/core/src/db/schema/tenancy.test.ts#tenantPairingFault`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.owned_row_has_exactly_one_owner`** — In every consistent state of today's database, every row of a table whose owner column is `NOT NULL` has exactly one owning principal, in its own workspace.
  - Statement: `∀ (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State), AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.consistent st = true → ∀ {t : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName} {c : String}, AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.ownerColumn? t = some c → t ≠ AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.auditEvents → ∀ {r : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row}, r ∈ st t → ∃ p, p ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.workspacePrincipals ∧ p.get "id" = r.get c ∧ p.get "workspace_id" = r.get "workspace_id" ∧ ∀ (p' : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row), p' ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.workspacePrincipals → p'.get "id" = r.get c → p' = p`
  - Cites: `docs/sdk/04-api-specification.md#2-resource-model`, `docs/sdk/site/concepts/workspaces-and-principals.mdx#workspace-and-principal`, `packages/core/src/db/schema/agents.ts#agents_owner_principal_workspace_fk`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.owner_is_mandatory_except_for_audit_actors`** — The owner column is `NOT NULL` on every table that has one except `audit_events`, whose actor may be a deleted principal or none.
  - Statement: `∀ (t : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName) (c : String), AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.ownerColumn? t = some c → (AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue t).isNotNull c = (t != AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.auditEvents)`
  - Cites: `docs/sdk/04-api-specification.md#2-resource-model`, `packages/core/src/db/schema/audit-events.ts#auditEvents`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.owner_reference_names_exactly_one_principal`** — In every consistent state of today's database, a row whose owner column is set names exactly one principal, and that principal belongs to the row's own workspace.
  - Statement: `∀ (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State), AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.consistent st = true → ∀ {t : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName} {c : String}, AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.ownerColumn? t = some c → ∀ {r : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row}, r ∈ st t → (r.get c).isSome = true → ∃ p, p ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.workspacePrincipals ∧ p.get "id" = r.get c ∧ p.get "workspace_id" = r.get "workspace_id" ∧ ∀ (p' : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row), p' ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.workspacePrincipals → p'.get "id" = r.get c → p' = p`
  - Cites: `docs/sdk/04-api-specification.md#2-resource-model`, `docs/sdk/site/concepts/workspaces-and-principals.mdx#workspace-and-principal`, `packages/core/src/db/schema/agents.ts#agents_owner_principal_workspace_fk`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.reachable_state_has_no_cross_workspace_reference`** — No sequence of committed transactions, whatever rows any writer sends, reaches a state of today's database with a reference from one workspace to a tenant-carrying row of another.
  - Statement: `∀ {st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State}, AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.Reachable AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.consistent st → ∀ {t : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName} {fk : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.ForeignKey} {r r' : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row}, (AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue fk.refTable).tenantColumn?.isSome = true → AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.References AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue st t fk r r' → AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.tenantOf AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue t r = AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.tenantOf AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue fk.refTable r'`
  - Cites: `docs/architecture.md#runtime-and-trust-boundaries`, `docs/formal/00-orchestrator-prompt.md#61-tiers`, `packages/core/src/db/schema/tenancy.test.ts#tenantPairingFault`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.reachable_state_satisfies_constraints`** — Every state a database with constraint set `P` reaches from empty, by any sequence of committed transactions, satisfies `P`, provided the empty database does.
  - Statement: `∀ (P : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State → Bool), P AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State.empty = true → ∀ {st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State}, AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.Reachable P st → P st = true`
  - Cites: `docs/formal/00-orchestrator-prompt.md#61-tiers`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.reference_chain_stays_in_workspace`** — In every consistent state of today's whole schema, every row reached from a row by a chain of references through tenant-carrying tables belongs to the starting row's workspace.
  - Statement: `∀ (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State), AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.consistent st = true → ∀ {t t' : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName} {r r' : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row}, AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TenantPath AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue st t r t' r' → AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.tenantOf AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue t r = AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.tenantOf AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue t' r'`
  - Cites: `docs/architecture.md#runtime-and-trust-boundaries`, `packages/core/src/db/schema/tenancy.test.ts#tenantPairingFault`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.shared_checks_agree`** — The two checks two clusters both give a meaning to, `workspaces_default_model_pair` (identity and configuration) and `projects_default_model_pair` (work and configuration), mean the same on every row in both clusters.
  - Statement: `∀ (r : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row), Option.all (fun x => x.holds r) (AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.Identity.semantics? "workspaces_default_model_pair") = AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.Configuration.configCheckHolds "workspaces_default_model_pair" r ∧ AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.Work.workCheckHolds "projects_default_model_pair" r = AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.Configuration.configCheckHolds "projects_default_model_pair" r`
  - Cites: `docs/sdk/04-api-specification.md#53-model-connections-and-models--awmodels`, `packages/core/src/db/schema/workspaces.ts#workspaces`, `packages/core/src/db/schema/projects.ts#projects`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.target_empty_database_is_consistent`** — The empty database satisfies every constraint of the target.
  - Statement: `AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.consistent AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State.empty = true`
  - Cites: `docs/formal/concepts.md#the-target-er-model`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.target_grant_names_one_principal_of_its_workspace`** — In every consistent state of the target, a grant names exactly one principal, and it is a principal of the grant's own workspace.
  - Statement: `∀ (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State), AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.consistent st = true → ∀ {r : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row}, r ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.agentGrants → ∃ p, p ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.workspacePrincipals ∧ p.get "id" = r.get "principal_id" ∧ p.get "workspace_id" = r.get "workspace_id" ∧ ∀ (p' : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row), p' ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.workspacePrincipals → p'.get "id" = r.get "principal_id" → p' = p`
  - Cites: `docs/sdk/site/concepts/ownership-and-sharing.mdx#catalog-assignment-grant`, `packages/core/src/db/schema/agent-grants.ts#agentGrants`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.target_has_no_cross_workspace_reference`** — In every consistent state of the target schema, no foreign-key reference joins a row of one workspace to a tenant-carrying row of another.
  - Statement: `∀ (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State), AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.consistent st = true → ∀ {t : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName} {fk : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.ForeignKey} {r r' : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row}, (AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.schema fk.refTable).tenantColumn?.isSome = true → AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.References AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.schema st t fk r r' → AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.tenantOf AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.schema t r = AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.tenantOf AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.schema fk.refTable r'`
  - Cites: `docs/formal/concepts.md#the-target-er-model`, `docs/architecture.md#runtime-and-trust-boundaries`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.target_reachable_grant_names_one_principal`** — In every state reachable under the target's constraints, a grant names exactly one principal, of the grant's own workspace.
  - Statement: `∀ {st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State}, AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.Reachable AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.consistent st → ∀ {r : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row}, r ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.agentGrants → ∃ p, p ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.workspacePrincipals ∧ p.get "id" = r.get "principal_id" ∧ p.get "workspace_id" = r.get "workspace_id" ∧ ∀ (p' : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row), p' ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.workspacePrincipals → p'.get "id" = r.get "principal_id" → p' = p`
  - Cites: `docs/adr/FORMAL-P1-grants-name-principals.md#decision`, `packages/core/src/db/schema/agent-grants.ts#agentGrants`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.target_reachable_share_subject_stays_in_workspace`** — In every state reachable under the target's constraints, a share's subject column names exactly one row of its subject type's table, in the share's own workspace.
  - Statement: `∀ {st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State}, AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.Reachable AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.consistent st → ∀ (ty : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Share.SubjectType) {r : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row}, r ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.shares → (r.get (AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.subjectColumn ty)).isSome = true → ∃ s, s ∈ st ty.table ∧ s.get "id" = r.get (AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.subjectColumn ty) ∧ s.get "workspace_id" = r.get "workspace_id" ∧ ∀ (s' : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row), s' ∈ st ty.table → s'.get "id" = r.get (AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.subjectColumn ty) → s' = s`
  - Cites: `docs/adr/FORMAL-P1-share-subject-is-a-typed-reference.md#decision`, `apps/web/server/composition/wiring/projects.ts#subjectOwnership`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.target_reachable_state_has_no_cross_workspace_reference`** — No sequence of committed transactions under the target's constraints reaches a state with a reference from one workspace to a tenant-carrying row of another.
  - Statement: `∀ {st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State}, AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.Reachable AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.consistent st → ∀ {t : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName} {fk : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.ForeignKey} {r r' : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row}, (AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.schema fk.refTable).tenantColumn?.isSome = true → AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.References AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.schema st t fk r r' → AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.tenantOf AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.schema t r = AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.tenantOf AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.schema fk.refTable r'`
  - Cites: `docs/formal/concepts.md#the-target-er-model`, `docs/architecture.md#runtime-and-trust-boundaries`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.target_share_subject_stays_in_workspace`** — In every consistent state of the target, a share's subject column names exactly one row of its subject type's table, and that row is in the share's own workspace: a share can no longer name a missing subject or another workspace's.
  - Statement: `∀ (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State), AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.consistent st = true → ∀ (ty : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Share.SubjectType) {r : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row}, r ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.shares → (r.get (AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.subjectColumn ty)).isSome = true → ∃ s, s ∈ st ty.table ∧ s.get "id" = r.get (AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.subjectColumn ty) ∧ s.get "workspace_id" = r.get "workspace_id" ∧ ∀ (s' : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row), s' ∈ st ty.table → s'.get "id" = r.get (AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.subjectColumn ty) → s' = s`
  - Cites: `docs/sdk/site/concepts/ownership-and-sharing.mdx#beyond-one-workspace`, `apps/web/server/composition/wiring/projects.ts#subjectOwnership`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.target_witness_is_reachable`** — The image of today's witness is reachable under the target's constraints: loading it into an empty target database in one transaction commits.
  - Statement: `AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.Reachable AgentWorkspace.Er.Target.consistent (AgentWorkspace.Er.Refinement.toTarget AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.Witness.state)`
  - Cites: `docs/formal/concepts.md#current-to-target-mapping`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.ErSynthesis.tenant_row_has_exactly_one_workspace`** — In every consistent state of today's database, every row of a tenant-scoped table has exactly one owning workspace: one `workspaces` row whose `id` is the row's `workspace_id`.
  - Statement: `∀ (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State), AgentWorkspace.Er.Current.consistent st = true → ∀ {t : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName}, (AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue t).tenancy = AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Tenancy.scoped → ∀ {r : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row}, r ∈ st t → ∃ w, w ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.workspaces ∧ w.get "id" = r.get "workspace_id" ∧ (w.get "id").isSome = true ∧ ∀ (w' : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row), w' ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.workspaces → w'.get "id" = r.get "workspace_id" → w' = w`
  - Cites: `docs/sdk/site/concepts/workspaces-and-principals.mdx#workspace-and-principal`, `packages/core/src/db/schema/tenancy.test.ts#TENANT_COLUMN`

### T2 · EventsSse

- **`Theorems.Invariants.EventsSse.append_allocates_next_id`** — Every successful append allocates the next sequence number, independent of retention.
  - Statement: `∀ (limit : Nat) (log next : AgentWorkspace.Events.RunLog.Log) (event : AgentWorkspace.Events.RunLog.Event) (name : String) (data : AgentWorkspace.JValue), AgentWorkspace.Events.RunLog.append limit log name data = some (next, event) → event.id = log.lastId + 1 ∧ next.lastId = event.id`
  - Cites: `docs/sdk/site/concepts/run-lifecycle.mdx#the-event-stream`, `apps/web/server/runs/memory-store.ts#RunEventLog`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.EventsSse.append_retains_newest_suffix`** — Successful append keeps exactly the newest `limit` rows of the previous retained log plus the new event. This states the retention suffix, not merely its size.
  - Statement: `∀ (limit : Nat) (log next : AgentWorkspace.Events.RunLog.Log) (event : AgentWorkspace.Events.RunLog.Event) (name : String) (data : AgentWorkspace.JValue), AgentWorkspace.Events.RunLog.append limit log name data = some (next, event) → next.retained = List.drop (log.retained.length + 1 - limit) (log.retained ++ [event])`
  - Cites: `apps/web/server/runs/memory-store.ts#RunEventLog`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.EventsSse.closed_log_refuses_append`** — A closed event log refuses every subsequent append.
  - Statement: `∀ (limit : Nat) (log : AgentWorkspace.Events.RunLog.Log) (name : String) (data : AgentWorkspace.JValue), AgentWorkspace.Events.RunLog.append limit (AgentWorkspace.Events.RunLog.close log) name data = none`
  - Cites: `docs/sdk/site/concepts/run-lifecycle.mdx#the-event-stream`, `apps/web/server/runs/memory-store.ts#RunEventLog`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.EventsSse.invalid_header_blocks_query_fallback`** — An invalid present header cannot be replaced by a valid query cursor.
  - Statement: `∀ (header query : String), AgentWorkspace.Events.Resume.parseFrameId header = none → AgentWorkspace.Events.Resume.readResumeCursor (some header) (some query) = AgentWorkspace.Events.Resume.Cursor.invalid AgentWorkspace.Events.Resume.Source.header`
  - Cites: `apps/web/server/runs/cursor.ts#readResumeCursor`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.EventsSse.memory_follow_does_not_skip_tail`** — The in-memory stream cannot end before its cursor reaches the latest produced event.
  - Statement: `∀ (log : AgentWorkspace.Events.RunLog.Log) (cursor : Nat), AgentWorkspace.Events.RunLog.memoryMayEnd log cursor = true → cursor ≥ log.lastId`
  - Cites: `docs/sdk/site/concepts/run-lifecycle.mdx#the-event-stream`, `apps/web/server/runs/memory-store.ts#RunEventLog`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.EventsSse.memory_follow_waits_for_terminal`** — Catching up to the latest id is insufficient while the run remains open.
  - Statement: `∀ (log : AgentWorkspace.Events.RunLog.Log) (cursor : Nat), AgentWorkspace.Events.RunLog.memoryMayEnd log cursor = true → log.closed = true`
  - Cites: `apps/web/server/runs/memory-store.ts#RunEventLog`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.EventsSse.pending_is_strictly_after`** — Resume selects only retained events strictly later than the cursor.
  - Statement: `∀ (log : AgentWorkspace.Events.RunLog.Log) (cursor : Nat) (event : AgentWorkspace.Events.RunLog.Event), event ∈ AgentWorkspace.Events.RunLog.pending log cursor → event.id > cursor`
  - Cites: `docs/sdk/site/concepts/run-lifecycle.mdx#resuming`, `apps/web/server/runs/memory-store.ts#RunEventLog`

### T2 · GatewayIngress

- **`Theorems.Invariants.GatewayIngress.a_fragmented_tool_call_is_counted_once`** — One tool call whose arguments fragment across many chunks is charged once, because the deltas all repeat the same `(choice, index)` pair; three distinct pairs are three calls.
  - Statement: `(AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.extractChat [AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.ChatFrame.toolCallDelta 0 0, AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.ChatFrame.toolCallDelta 0 0, AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.ChatFrame.toolCallDelta 0 0, AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.ChatFrame.finish, AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.ChatFrame.usage 1 1 0]).counters.toolCalls = 1 ∧ (AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.extractChat [AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.ChatFrame.toolCallDelta 0 0, AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.ChatFrame.toolCallDelta 0 1, AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.ChatFrame.toolCallDelta 1 0, AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.ChatFrame.finish, AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.ChatFrame.usage 1 1 0]).counters.toolCalls = 3`
  - Cites: `packages/gateway/src/usage/chat-completions.ts#toolCallIdentity`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.GatewayIngress.a_repeated_function_call_is_counted_once`** — Counting distinct item identities is what stops a repeated `function_call` inflating the row: the stream and the terminal snapshot both name the same item, and it is charged once.
  - Statement: `(AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.extractResponses [AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.ResponsesFrame.functionCallDone "fc_1", AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.ResponsesFrame.functionCallDone "fc_1", AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.ResponsesFrame.terminal 1 1 0 ["fc_1"]]).counters.toolCalls = 1 ∧ (AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.extractResponses [AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.ResponsesFrame.functionCallDone "fc_1", AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.ResponsesFrame.functionCallDone "fc_2", AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.ResponsesFrame.terminal 1 1 0 ["fc_1", "fc_2"]]).counters.toolCalls = 2`
  - Cites: `packages/gateway/src/usage/responses.ts#itemIdentity`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.GatewayIngress.anthropic_extraction_is_prefix_monotone`** — Anthropic extraction never shrinks as more frames arrive: a truncated stream is charged no more than the whole one.
  - Statement: `∀ (frames : List AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.AnthropicFrame) (n : Nat), (AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.extractAnthropic (List.take n frames)).le (AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.GatewayIngress.extractAnthropic frames) = true`

- **`Theorems.Invariants.GatewayIngress.anthropic_without_a_usage_frame_measures_no_tokens`** — A sequence with no `usage` snapshot measures no tokens, however many other frames it carries: the extractor never invents a count.

  - Statement: `∀ (announced : List String) (e : AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.Engines.Pi.Event), (AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.Engines.Pi.step announced e).snd ≠ [] ∧ ∀ (f : AgentWorkspace.Events.AgentFrames.Frame), f ∈ (AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.Engines.Pi.step announced e).snd → AgentWorkspace.Behaviour.Engines.OpenAiAgents.isNeutral f = true`

### T2 · Release

- **`Theorems.Invariants.Release.pointer_targets_existing_version`** — Every environment points at a version that exists, for the same agent: a step from a well-formed state (every history entry names a saved version) reaches a well-formed state, so every pointer it leaves names a saved version.
  - Statement: `∀ (t : Option AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.Score) (r r' : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.Release) (op : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.Op), r.WellFormed → AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.step t r op = Except.ok r' → r'.WellFormed ∧ ∀ (a : AgentWorkspace.AgentId) (e : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.Env) (v : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.VersionNo), r'.pointer a e = some v → r'.hasVersion a v = true`
  - Cites: `docs/formal/domains/release.md#the-release-model`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.Release.rollback_after_promote_is_identity`** — Promote then rollback leaves the pointer where it was, whenever the target environment already pointed somewhere.
  - Statement: `∀ (t : Option AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.Score) (r r₁ : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.Release) (a : AgentWorkspace.AgentId) (src dst : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.Env), AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.step t r (AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.Op.promote a src dst) = Except.ok r₁ → (r.pointer a dst).isSome = true → ∃ r₂, AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.step t r₁ (AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.Op.rollback a dst) = Except.ok r₂ ∧ r₂.pointer a dst = r.pointer a dst`
  - Cites: `docs/formal/domains/release.md#the-release-model`, `apps/web/server/agent-versions/release.ts#decidePromote`, `apps/web/server/agent-versions/release.ts#decideRollback`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.Release.rollback_restores_previous`** — After `rollback`, the pointer equals the second entry of the history before the step, and the version it left comes off the history, so a second rollback steps further back (BH061-004).
  - Statement: `∀ (t : Option AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.Score) (r r' : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.Release) (a : AgentWorkspace.AgentId) (e : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.Env), AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.step t r (AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.Op.rollback a e) = Except.ok r' → ∃ cur prev rest, r.history a e = cur :: prev :: rest ∧ r'.pointer a e = some prev ∧ r'.history a e = prev :: rest`
  - Cites: `docs/formal/domains/release.md#the-release-model`, `apps/web/server/agent-versions/release.ts#decideRollback`
- **`Theorems.Invariants.Release.versions_append_only`** — No step deletes or changes a saved version: every agent's versions before a step are a prefix of its versions after it.
  - Statement: `∀ (t : Option AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.Score) (r r' : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.Release) (op : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.Op), AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Release.step t r op = Except.ok r' → ∀ (a : AgentWorkspace.AgentId), r.versions a <+: r'.versions a`
  - Cites: `docs/formal/domains/release.md#the-release-model`

Trivial as a proposition, and load-bearing as a statement: it is why re-deriving on every read cannot drift from what a fresh run produces, which a one-time data migration could not promise.
  - Statement: `∀ (systemSubtypes resultSubtypes eventTypes : List String) (data : AgentWorkspace.JValue), AgentWorkspace.Events.AgentFrames.upgradeLegacy systemSubtypes resultSubtypes eventTypes data = AgentWorkspace.Events.AgentFrames.upgradeLegacy systemSubtypes resultSubtypes eventTypes data`

"Do not invent a lossy mapping" as a theorem: the only frame such a row can produce is the one that says its envelope could not be read.
  - Statement: `∀ (systemSubtypes resultSubtypes eventTypes : List String) (data : AgentWorkspace.JValue) (reason : String), AgentWorkspace.Events.AgentFrames.legacyMessage data = Except.error reason → AgentWorkspace.Events.AgentFrames.upgradeLegacy systemSubtypes resultSubtypes eventTypes data = [AgentWorkspace.Events.AgentFrames.Frame.malformed reason]`
